quotes: Year-to-date through Q3, we generated Operating Cash Flow of $886 million and Free Cash Flow (“FCF”) of $832 million.

growth_thesis.basis: Guidance and attribution are stated in the release; the payback condition is inferred.
growth_thesis.claim: Near-term growth is guided to be flat, with higher marketing spend. Q4 total revenue guidance is $865 million to $875 million, and management attributes the expected Y/Y decline in Adjusted EBITDA largely to increased marketing spend at Tinder and Hinge. That spend must produce user and Payer gains for it to count as growth investment.
quotes: The Y/Y decline in Adjusted EBITDA is largely due to increased marketing spend at Tinder and Hinge and a gain on sale related to an LA office building in the prior year quarter.

growth_thesis.basis: Stated in the 10-Q and prepared remarks; the condition is inferred.
growth_thesis.claim: Everyone Everywhere (E&E) is a drag that must stabilize for the portfolio to grow. Q3 E&E Direct Revenue fell 20%, including a $20 million decrease at Azar after its app redesign, and Payers fell 23%.
quotes: E&E Direct Revenue declined 20%, including a $20 million decrease in revenue at Azar resulting from the changes discussed in the Azar business update above.

material_events.claim: Apple removed the Azar app from the Apple App Store. A new version was reinstated after updates to comply with Apple's guidelines. The updated app monetizes less, which lowered Azar Direct Revenue in the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026.
quotes: On February 22, 2026, Apple removed the Azar app from the Apple App Store following a February 6, 2026 update to Apple’s App Review Guidelines.
Updates were subsequently made to the app to comply with the updated guidelines, which led to the reinstatement of a new version on April 6, 2026.

material_events.claim: In the quarter ended March 31, 2026 the company recorded a $25.2 million impairment of the Azar trade name, an indefinite-lived asset. It was reclassified to a definite-lived intangible asset.
quotes: During the quarter ended March 31, 2026, we also updated the business forecast associated with the Azar app, which resulted in an impairment of $25.2 million to the indefinite-lived asset associated with the Azar trade name, which was reclassified to a definite-lived intangible asset as of March 31, 2026.

material_events.basis: stated in P4; the amount is read from the F3 cash flow line
material_events.claim: The 0.875% Exchangeable Senior Notes were repaid at maturity. The cash flow statement shows payments to settle exchangeable notes of 423,854 (table in thousands) for the nine months, and the current maturities of long-term debt line went to 0 at September 30, 2026.
quotes: The 0.875% Exchangeable Senior Notes which were repaid at maturity on June 15, 2026.

material_events.claim: The company reorganized its brands into three operating segments. Evergreen and Emerging and MG Asia were combined into a new segment called Everyone Everywhere, and historical periods were recast.
quotes: During the quarter ended June 30, 2026, we reorganized our brands into three operating segments.

material_events.claim: The Board declared a cash dividend of $0.20 per share, payable on January 21, 2027 to shareholders of record on January 6, 2027.
quotes: Match Group's Board of Directors has declared a cash dividend of $0.20 per share of the company's common stock.

risks.basis: stated in the cited items (10-Q MD&A and Q3 prepared remarks). The link to the risk is inferred.
risks.claim: Tinder, the largest segment, is still losing payers and revenue. Q3 Tinder Direct Revenue fell 2% on a 4% payer decline, and monthly active users were down 5.5%. If the user recovery stalls, revenue stays under pressure.
quotes: Tinder Direct Revenue declined 2%, driven by a 4% decrease in Payers, partially offset by an increase in RPP of 2%.
MAU declines narrowed to 5.5%, a one-point improvement from Q2.

risks.basis: expiry and fee risk stated in the 10-K risk factors. The size of any impact is not stated, and the packet gives no post-expiry terms.
risks.claim: The Google partnership that helps offset app-store costs is set to expire in the first quarter of 2027. The filing expects fees to rise if Google does not cut its standard in-app purchase fees by then. Recent cost-of-revenue savings depend on payment-fee dynamics at Apple and Google.
quotes: In particular, our partnership with Google entered into in 2024 is set to expire in the first quarter of 2027.

Cost of revenue decreased across all segments primarily due to Payers shifting from app store payments to alternate payment methods, resulting in $43.0 million lower in-app purchase fees partially offset by an increase of $4.5 million in credit card processing fees.

risks.basis: stated in the 10-Q MD&A and the 10-K risk factors. The extension to other brands is inferred from the general dependency language.
risks.claim: Azar shows the app-store dependency: Apple removed the app, and the redesign needed for reinstatement monetizes less. The new version lowered Azar revenue by $20 million in Q3 and contributed to a 20% fall in E&E Direct Revenue.
quotes: The app updates necessitated by the new guidelines resulted in lower monetization from the new app.

risks.basis: balances, maturity and leverage stated in the cited items. The risk characterization is inferred.
risks.claim: The balance sheet is leveraged. Shareholders' equity is negative at (139,469) and long-term debt is 3,553,307, against cash of 726,196 (table in thousands), down from 1,027,838 at year-end. Net leverage was 2.0x and gross leverage 2.6x. $450 million of 5.00% Senior Notes mature in December 2027, and cash returns to shareholders were large.
quotes: 5.00% Senior Notes due December 15, 2027
net leverage was 2.0x at the end of Q3

risks.basis: guidance and drivers stated in the earnings release and prepared remarks. Whether marketing spend pays back is not shown.
risks.claim: Earnings are guided lower for Q4. Adjusted EBITDA is guided to $327.5 million to $332.5 million, an 11% year-over-year decrease, largely because of higher marketing spend at Tinder and Hinge and a prior-year building gain. In Q3, Adjusted EBITDA excluding the prior-year legal charge was already down 5% for the same marketing reason.
quotes: Excluding the legal settlement charge in Q3 2025, Adjusted EBITDA was down 5% in Q3 2026, primarily due to higher marketing spend at Tinder and Hinge.
The Y/Y decline in Adjusted EBITDA is largely due to increased marketing spend at Tinder and Hinge and a gain on sale related to an LA office building in the prior year quarter.

risks.basis: past settlements and pending suits stated in the 10-K. Future outcomes are not in the evidence.
risks.claim: Legal and regulatory exposure has already produced costs. 2025 general and administrative expense included a $60.5 million Tinder legal settlement and a $14.0 million FTC settlement. Lawsuits alleging user harm are pending in Colorado and Texas.
quotes: a legal settlement at Tinder in the amount of $60.5 million
a settlement with the FTC in the amount of $14.0 million related to certain E&E applications
we are currently defending lawsuits in Colorado and Texas brought by multiple plaintiffs alleging harm by other users they met through our services.

risks.basis: impairment stated in the 10-Q MD&A and the 10-K lists impairment as a risk. Any further charge is inferred.
risks.claim: Intangible-asset impairment risk is live. The company recorded a $25.2 million impairment on the Azar trade name in Q1 2026 after cutting its Azar forecast. Goodwill remains large at 2,340,393 (table in thousands) against total assets of 4,192,268.
quotes: an impairment of $25.2 million to the indefinite-lived asset associated with the Azar trade name

unresolved_questions.basis: Stated in the cited items. The link from user trends to revenue is management's claim and has not yet been shown.

quotes: Tinder Direct Revenue declined 2%, driven by a 4% decrease in Payers, partially offset by an increase in RPP of 2%.
DAU inflected to Y/Y growth in September, and was down just 1% Y/Y in Q3.

unresolved_questions.basis: Stated in the cited items. Persistence beyond Q3 is not addressed.

quotes: The app updates necessitated by the new guidelines resulted in lower monetization from the new app.

unresolved_questions.basis: The expiry and the 10-K's fee-increase warning are stated in the cited items. The size of any 2027 effect is not given.

representing an 11% Y/ Y decrease
